observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor uses an enthusiastic and encouraging teaching style, breaking down steps clearly while addressing body posture differences between men and women. She maintains an upbeat energy throughout the tutorial, demonstrating movements patiently and repeatedly.

lesson_structure.note: Welcome greeting and introduction to the Peruvian waltz (vals criollo).
Arm positioning details for men and women.

common_mistakes: Moving too much or balancing outside the spot instead of keeping everything in place.

steps_taught.name: Paso 1
steps_taught.description: Basic flat and semi-point step in place with subtle hip movement.

steps_taught.name: Paso 2
steps_taught.description: Zigzag stepping pattern with flat and semi-point footwork.

steps_taught.name: Paso 3
steps_taught.description: Stepping and closing with minimal displacement or dragging.

what_works: Clear step numbering and progressive breakdown
Separate explanations for female and male arm positions
what_hinders: Fast transitions during music practice without prior slow walkthrough with music

quotes.text: El día de hoy vamos a aprender unos pasos básicos del vals criollo.
El número uno es totalmente plano y el número dos es un poquito en media punta.
Todo en el sitio, no me muevo, no me balanceo.
No abro demasiado, sino es súper chiquito y sutil.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor stands facing front with hands on hips, explaining step 1 while counting aloud.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact weight distribution on floor tiles

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates side angle view to show the zigzag step crossing.
Instructor turns back to camera to demonstrate male arm placement on the back.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact hand pressure against partner's back

extraction.distinctive_method: Explaining distinct posture and arm placement variations explicitly tailored separately for men and women during a solo instruction video.
